mapper.sql: SELECT h.*,u.username,u.display_name FROM help_requests h JOIN users u ON u.id=h.student_id

JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=h.offering_id AND m.user_id=h.student_id WHERE 1=1 AND m.status='active' AND m.role='student' AND h.student_id=#{studentId}AND h.offering_id=#{offeringId}AND h.status=#{status}
mapper.select: ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO help_requests(id,offering_id,assignment_id,student_id,title,content,student_attempt,workspace_revision,shared_snapshot,shared_snapshot_expires_at,shared_tutoring_request_ids,issue_tags,issue_tag_version,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{offeringId},#{assignmentId},#{studentId},#{title},#{content},#{studentAttempt},#{workspaceRevision},CAST(#{sharedSnapshot} AS JSON),#{sharedSnapshotExpiresAt},CAST(#{sharedTutoringRequestIds} AS JSON),CAST(#{issueTags} AS JSON),#{issueTagVersion},#{status},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE help_requests SET status=#{status},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO help_replies(id,help_request_id,offering_id,author_id,content,created_at) SELECT #{id},#{helpRequestId},offering_id,#{authorId},#{content},#{createdAt} FROM help_requests WHERE id=#{helpRequestId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*,u.display_name FROM help_replies r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.author_id WHERE help_request_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications(id,recipient_id,type,title,content,related_offering_id,related_assignment_id,target_type,target_id,related_help_reply_id,source_event_key,created_at) VALUES(#{id},#{recipient},'help_reply','教师回复了你的求助',#{content},#{offering},#{assignment},'help_request',#{help},#{reply},CONCAT('help_reply:',#{reply}),#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE help_requests SET shared_snapshot=NULL,shared_snapshot_purged_at=#{now} WHERE shared_snapshot_expires_at <= #{now} AND shared_snapshot_purged_at IS NULL AND workspace_revision IS NOT NULL
